sections.heading: Part I — Free-Response Questions (FRQs): Foundational Fluency (1–7)

questions.q: Data table #901 lists 10 symmetric observations with frequencies [2, 3, 3, 2]. Find the mental arithmetic mean.
questions.answer:
**Quick Tactic:** Because weights \([2,3,3,2]\) are symmetric, the mean equals the midpoint between \(15\) and \(17\), which is \(16\).
**Mathematical Proof:** Weighted sum \(= 160 \div 10 = 16\).

questions.q: Given \(x=4\). Column A: \((x+2)^2\). Column B: \(x^2+4x+4\). Compare the two columns.
questions.target: Algebraic comparisons at a fixed value
questions.answer: \((x+2)^2\) expands to \(x^2+4x+4\) for every value of \(x\), so the columns are always equal. \(A=B\).

questions.q: For any real number \(x\): Column A: \(x\). Column B: \(x^2\). Compare the two columns.
questions.answer: If \(x=2\): \(B>A\). If \(x=\frac{1}{2}\): \(A>B\). If \(x=1\): \(A=B\). The relationship changes, so it cannot be determined.
questions.explanation: If \(x=2\): \(B>A\). If \(x=\frac{1}{2}\): \(A>B\). If \(x=1\): \(A=B\). The relationship changes, so it cannot be determined.

questions.q: For any real number \(x\): Column A: \(x+5\). Column B: \(2x\). Compare the two columns.
questions.answer: If \(x=5\): \(A=B\). If \(x=0\): \(A>B\). If \(x=10\): \(B>A\). The relationship changes, so it cannot be determined.
questions.explanation: If \(x=5\): \(A=B\). If \(x=0\): \(A>B\). If \(x=10\): \(B>A\). The relationship changes, so it cannot be determined.

questions.q:
إذا كانت المصفوفة \( f_{x} = \begin{pmatrix} 12 & 1 \\ 8 & 3 \end{pmatrix} \)، فما قيمة المحدد \( \det(f_{x}) \)؟
Given the matrix \( f_{x} = \begin{pmatrix} 12 & 1 \\ 8 & 3 \end{pmatrix} \), what is the determinant \( \det(f_{x}) \)?
questions.answer:
**Answer:** C. محدد المصفوفة يساوي \( (12)(3) - (1)(8) = 28 \).
The determinant is \( (12)(3) - (1)(8) = 28 \).

questions.q:
متوازي أضلاع قاعدته 10 سم وارتفاعه 12 سم. ما مساحته؟
A parallelogram has base 10 cm and height 12 cm. What is its area?
questions.answer:
**Answer:** D. بتطبيق القواعد الرياضية في Geometry & Measurement: \( 10\times12=120 \) cm\(^2\) وبالتالي فإن الإجابة الصحيحة هي 120.
Applying Geometry & Measurement principles: \( 10\times12=120 \) cm\(^2\) Therefore, the correct choice is 120.
